metadata.title: When 2 accidental kills make me question if I’m hacking or just dumb lucky
metadata.description:
Didn’t even mean to shoot but hey, 2 kills happened.
Enemy probably uninstalling for their own sanity.
Click if your aim’s a mess but luck’s got your back.
Watch me act like this was all planned!

Tap if your aim’s broken but you still get the kills!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
